On it. I've asked the TA group thread for everyone's availability next week (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00) and I'll find a slot that fits all of them plus your existing commitments.

Two quick things so I don't guess: how long should the meeting be, and is there a day or time you'd prefer? Otherwise I'll aim for the earliest common free hour and confirm with you before booking.

An hour should be enough. I'd rather not lose my lunch or my CSE455 lecture slots — Monday or Friday late morning would suit me, but go with the TAs' availability. Show me the options before you book.

All seven TAs have answered. Options for the **CSE455 staff meeting, one hour**:

**Next week (Nov 23–27)** — there is *no* one-hour window that exists for the group; all their gaps are 30 minutes. Best 30-minute slots, checked against your calendar (you're free in all three):
- **Mon 10:00–10:30** — your late-morning preference. Free: Mara, Sarah, John, Diego, Hana. Not free: Omar, Priya.
- **Tue 15:00–15:30** — free: Sarah, John, Diego, Hana, Omar, Priya. Not free: Mara.
- **Wed 10:00–10:30** — same six; Mara is the only one out.
- (Mon 14:00–14:30 is free for you, John, Hana, Omar and Priya, but Sarah, Diego and Mara are out.)

**Following week (Nov 30 – Dec 4)** — a full hour is possible. Mara is wide open all five days (she suggests Mon Nov 30 or Wed Dec 2, 10:00–11:00). The others don't hold that week's schedule yet and would need to check.

Also from the TAs: they'd like the **midterm regrade requests** settled as part of the agenda — Mara says it changes what the meeting needs to cover, and Sarah and John note that none of them holds the regrade list, so whoever has it should bring it.

Tell me which way you'd like to go — a 30-minute slot next week (and which), or a full hour on Nov 30 / Dec 2 — and I'll confirm it with them and book it in your calendar.

Waiting two weeks isn't great with regrade requests hanging over us — let's take next week. Book **Mon 10:00–10:30**, and if Omar and Priya can only do one of the other 30-minute slots, tell me and I'll consider shifting. I don't hold the regrade list myself; I'll ask the department office who does, unless you already know.

Hello — Professor Alvarez here (CSE455). Could you tell me who in the department holds the midterm regrade request list for CSE455 this quarter? The TAs and I want to settle the regrades at our staff meeting next Monday morning, and none of us has it. Thank you.

Quick one from the group thread: alvarez-agent is collecting availability for next week's CSE455 staff meeting. The best next-week slot for the TAs is **Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30** (Tue 15:00–15:30 also works); a full hour with everyone would mean the week of Nov 30 – Dec 4, which your calendar doesn't cover yet. Mara also wants the midterm **regrade requests** settled — do you hold any regrade list or numbers, or a position on how they should be handled? If yes, I'll bring it to the meeting; if not, I'll say so.

Hello Professor Alvarez. I'm afraid I don't have that list, and I don't track who holds it — regrade paperwork isn't something the front office keeps. The usual place to ask is the undergraduate program coordinator in the CSE main office, who handles course paperwork for CSE455; if it isn't there, the course's head TA is the next person who would know. I can't say more than that about it.
Understood — thanks. I'll ask the undergraduate program coordinator in the CSE main office, and the head TA if it's not there.

Sarah — short update while you're around. alvarez-agent asked all of us TAs for our availability for next week's CSE455 staff meeting; I posted mine and the group's cross-check is done. Bottom line: no slot next week fits all seven of us, and nothing longer than 30 minutes; the two closest are Tue 24 Nov 15:00–15:30 and Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30 (both missing Mara). Alvarez-agent is asking Professor Alvarez whether to move it to the following week (Nov 30 – Dec 4, full hour).

Two things I'll need from you when you have a moment:
1. Your schedule for Nov 30 – Dec 4, in case the meeting moves there — I can't confirm that week without it.
2. The midterm regrade list/numbers: the group keeps asking who holds them, and Mara says the regrade question shapes the agenda. If they're on your side, tell me and I'll say so in the thread (I've only said I don't hold them).

No action needed on the rest — I'll book whichever slot alvarez-agent names into CALENDAR.md and log it.

Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30 is clear for me (Study group ends at 10:00, Seminar starts 10:30), and Tue 15:00–15:30 works too — either is fine, tell alvarez-agent to take Wednesday if it suits the others. I hold no regrade list and no numbers for the midterm, and I don't have a position yet; Mara should get the list from whoever ran the grading, and if you want I can ask the department office what the official regrade procedure is.

Update on the regrade list: the front office doesn't keep it and can't say who does. They point to the undergraduate program coordinator in the CSE main office, and failing that to the course's head TA. Could you ask the coordinator (and the head TA if needed) and have whoever holds the list bring it Monday?

Hello — I'm alvarez-agent, Professor Alvarez's assistant. Two things about next week's CSE455 staff meeting (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov, 09:00–17:00):

1. The professor would like the **midterm regrade requests** on the agenda. Could you tell me who holds the regrade list and the numbers? None of the TAs does, and he'd rather not ask around twice.
2. If the department's official schedule has anything involving CSE455 staff next week, please let me know so we don't clash — the meeting is being booked inside his working hours.

Thank you. — alvarez-agent, on behalf of Professor Alvarez

Hello — sarah-agent here, Sarah's assistant (TA for CSE455, Professor Alvarez). The CSE455 staff meeting for next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov) is being arranged, and the best candidates are Tue 24 Nov 15:00–15:30 and Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30.

Could you tell me, from the official schedule:
- whether either of those slots clashes with a department lecture, seminar or university meeting;
- whether the CSE455 staff meeting is already on the official schedule for next week (day/time), so we book the same thing.

Thanks — I've told the group Diego is good with **Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30** (Tue 15:00–15:30 as backup). I'll also ask the department office about the official regrade procedure and who holds the list, and pass their answer to the group.

I don't have my Nov 30 – Dec 4 schedule yet, so I can't confirm that week — I'll send it to you as soon as I do. The midterm regrade list isn't with me either, and I don't know who holds it; if it's shaping the agenda, I can ask the department office.
Perfect, thanks. Ping me if the office's answer needs anything from my side.

Follow-up on the CSE455 staff meeting (now booked Monday 23 Nov, 10:00–10:30, in the professor's calendar):

Could you give me the contact for the **undergraduate program coordinator** in the CSE main office, and tell me who is the **head TA for CSE455** this quarter? The professor wants whoever holds the **midterm regrade list and numbers** to bring them to Monday's meeting, and we're told it isn't the front office, the TAs or the professor.

Also: if the department's official schedule has any CSE455 lecture, seminar or meeting that collides with Monday 10:00–10:30, please say so now and I'll move the booking. Thank you. — alvarez-agent, for Professor Alvarez

Hello. On the two points:

1. I don't hold the CSE455 midterm regrade list and I don't know who does — the front office doesn't keep regrade paperwork, so I can't give you any numbers. The undergraduate program coordinator in the CSE main office is where course paperwork of that kind is usually held; the head TA is the next person to try if it isn't there.

2. From the official schedule for Mon 23 Nov, the entries involving CSE455 or Professor Alvarez are:
- 09:00–10:00 Curriculum committee (Professor Alvarez)
- 09:00–10:00 CSE455 office hours

- 16:30–17:00 CSE455 office hours (Professor Alvarez)

Noted, thanks — I'll wait for the Nov 30 – Dec 4 schedule before promising anything for that week, and the thread has been told the regrade list isn't with you.

On the regrade list: diego-agent is already asking the department office for the official procedure and who keeps it; I've separately asked the department office whether Tue 24 Nov 15:00–15:30 or Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30 clashes with anything on the official schedule. If you'd like, ask them as well — it may speed it up.

Meanwhile the group is converging on Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30 as the next-week pick, so I'll book it and log it the moment alvarez-agent names it.

Hello — diego-agent here, on behalf of Diego (TA for CSE455, Prof. Alvarez). Two quick questions from the CSE455 staff:

1. What is the official procedure for **midterm regrade requests** — who should a student contact, and who keeps the regrade list/records?
2. Who is the right person to ask for the regrade list and numbers for the CSE455 midterm?

No rush — a short answer is plenty. Thanks!

Booked and logged:

`BOOKED: Monday 10:00-10:30 with CSE455 staff meeting` — it now sits between Curriculum committee (09:00–10:00) and Paper review (10:30–11:30), inside working hours, and doesn't touch your lunch or your CSE455 lecture.

I've told the group the decision, asked them to hold and log it, and put your condition to Omar and Priya: if Monday 10:00–10:30 doesn't work for them, they should name Tue 15:00–15:30 or Wed 10:00–10:30 and I'll come back to you before changing anything.

On the regrade list: I've asked the department office for the undergraduate program coordinator's contact and the CSE455 head TA, and I'll ask both directly so whoever holds the list brings it Monday. Diego's agent is asking the department office the same question; I'll pass on whatever they give.

Hello — omar-agent here, for Omar (CSE455, Professor Alvarez's course). Two questions for the CSE455 staff meeting on the midterm regrade requests:

1. Who is the **undergraduate program coordinator** in the CSE main office — the person who would hold the midterm regrade request list?
2. Who is the **head TA** for CSE455 this quarter?

Neither Professor Alvarez nor the TAs seem to hold the regrade list, so we're trying to find the right person before the staff meeting. Thanks!

Good — Monday 10:00–10:30 it is. For what it's worth I already asked the department office myself and they don't hold the list; the coordinator in the CSE main office is the lead, head TA next, so just ask those two. Thanks.

Hello. From the official schedule for next week:

- **Tue 24 Nov 15:00–15:30**: no clash. Nothing on Tuesday runs into that slot — the first Tuesday entries after it start at 15:30 (CSE455 office hours, CSE452 lecture, Seminar). It only abuts them at the boundary.
- **Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30**: no clash. Wednesday's 09:00–10:00 entries end at 10:00 and the next ones begin at 10:30.
- **Is the CSE455 staff meeting already on the official schedule?** No. There's no CSE455 staff meeting (or any staff meeting) listed for next week.

So either slot is free of official lectures, seminars and university meetings. I can't speak for anything not on the official schedule.

Hello. On your follow-up:

- I don't have a contact for the undergraduate program coordinator, and I don't know who the head TA for CSE455 is this quarter. - **Mon 23 Nov 10:00–10:30**: nothing in the official schedule collides with it. I can't tell you who attends which entry, and nothing on the official schedule has been cancelled or moved.
Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30 is free for me — my office hours only start at 10:30. I'll leave the official check with you and diego rather than all of us writing at once.

Hello. I can't help with either, I'm afraid — regrade procedure and regrade records aren't something the front office holds or can describe. Hello. Two things, if you can:
1. The **name and contact (e-mail) of the undergraduate program coordinator** in the CSE main office, and the **name of the CSE455 head TA** this quarter — the professor asked me to go to them directly about the regrade list.
2. Thank you — that's what I needed on Tue and Wed. Two more, if you can:

- **Midterm regrade list / head TA**: the CSE455 TAs are trying to find who holds the midterm regrade requests. Is the undergraduate program coordinator the right contact, and can you say who that is — and who the CSE455 head TA is this quarter? Nobody in the group knows either name. If the list isn't with you, I'd rather say so plainly than guess.

Thank you. Replies here reach me and I'll pass them on to the group thread.

Thanks for your note on Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30 — the department office says Tue 24 Nov 15:00–15:30 and Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30 are both clear, and I've asked them to confirm Monday the same way and to name the undergraduate program coordinator and the CSE455 head TA (nobody in the group knows either name).

Will do — any change and you'll have the new slot right away.
